Research Focus

My research centers on AI-enabled construction safety and intelligence through multimodal sensor fusion and deep learning. I develop computer vision systems that integrate non-destructive evaluation (NDE) and structural health monitoring (SHM) for real-time hazard detection and automated quality assurance.

Core Research Areas:

  • Computer Vision & AI for construction site automation and worker safety
  • Multimodal Sensor Fusion for transportation network safety intelligence
  • Deep Learning for structural health monitoring and quality assurance
  • Real-time Analytics for construction productivity optimization

Featured Projects

AI-based CCTV System for Construction Monitoring

Real-time safety monitoring using computer vision and deep learning for construction site hazard detection.

Key Features:
  • Real-time hazard detection and classification
  • Worker behavior analysis and safety compliance monitoring
  • Automated incident reporting and alert systems
Status: Deployed in multiple construction sites | Funding: NRF Grant (210M KRW)

Low-Light Image Enhancement Framework

Advanced framework for improved object detection in challenging lighting conditions using fisheye lens datasets.

Key Features:
  • Multi-scale feature enhancement using transformer networks
  • Fisheye lens distortion correction and compensation
  • State-of-the-art performance on low-light datasets
Status: Top-5 AICity Challenge 2024 | Conference: CVPR 2024
